meaning: A small test on a website, like picking pictures with traffic lights. It checks that you are a person, not a computer program.
clues: It is a small test you meet on some websites.
It is not about who you are. It is about whether you are a person.
You may be asked to pick every picture with a bus, or to read wobbly letters.
It helps stop automatic programs from making thousands of fake accounts.
It is all capital letters, has seven letters, and starts with C.
assumes: A pop-up is a small window that appears suddenly
A security question asks something only you would know
A one-time code works only once

decoys.meaning: A small window that suddenly appears over the web page you are reading.
A question, such as your first pet's name, that you answer to prove who you are.
A number sent to you that works only once, to prove it is you.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I never had to prove I was not a robot. Though I am a floppy disk, so, fair question.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Ha! Tip: if the pictures are too hard, there is usually a refresh button or a listen option.
